# Open Lakehouse Compute Fabric (OLCF)

> Open-source (Apache-2.0) self-hosted lakehouse platform by Justin Dodrill (Microsoft Certified Technology Specialist and Database Administrator). It gives you your own Spark compute fabric on a laptop, on-premises machines, VMs or Kubernetes, extends Microsoft Fabric notebooks onto that compute (`olcf.run_remote()`), runs completely standalone, and includes OLCF Intelligence: discovery, lineage, glossary and governance. Python 3.11-3.13, no compiler needed. Beta, for trusted infrastructure.

Agents are welcome to set it up for people and to contribute. Start with AGENTS.md.

## Start here
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/jddevtime/open-lakehouse-compute-fabric/blob/main/AGENTS.md): set-up commands, development rules, test commands, boundaries
- [README.md](https://github.com/jddevtime/open-lakehouse-compute-fabric/blob/main/README.md): overview, diagrams, screenshots, install routes
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/jddevtime/open-lakehouse-compute-fabric/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): pull-request checklist, DCO sign-off

## Install (macOS, Linux; also a Mac without Xcode Command Line Tools)
- `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jddevtime/open-lakehouse-compute-fabric/main/scripts/install.sh | sh`
- or with uv (also Windows): `uv tool install --python 3.13 "olcf @ https://github.com/jddevtime/open-lakehouse-compute-fabric/archive/refs/heads/main.tar.gz"`
- then `olcf quickstart` and `olcf doctor`
